assumptions: All costs are hypothetical units, not observed. They set the ranking between options and are easy to change here.
A trailer swap removes up to the stated hours of a truck's delay for a flat cost. It is applied to a truck whose delay is already known.
A split load sends the parcels that would slip on a separate extra truck that runs on time. The cost is the distance of the lane times the rate, with a minimum.
Recovery is evaluated for routine truck delays. Cancellations and hub closures are not included.
Truck capacity is not enforced, so the extra truck always has room.
